En %@ tu privacidad es lo primero. La ap: At %@ your privacy comes first. The app works without an account and, if you don't sign in, collects no personal data. The account is optional: if you create one, we only store your email and your purchase records so you can use %@ on your other devices. Card payments are processed by Stripe, not by us. This policy explains what information the app uses, where it is stored and who it communicates with.
• Farm ID: el número público de tu granj:
• Farm ID: the public number of your Sunflower Land farm that you enter at the start. It is only used to look up that farm's public data.
• Farm data: timers, inventory, level and other public information returned by the Sunflower Land API for that Farm ID.
• Preferences: app settings (currency, notifications, home order, daily plan, etc.).
• Account (optional): if you sign in, your email and the open session (see section 4).
• %@ status: whether you have the free version, the free trial, the quarterly subscription or the one-time payment plan, and the renewal date. It is checked with Stripe through the app's intermediary and, if you are signed in, also with your account, to unlock features.
• Temporary copies (cache): market prices, radar history and game images, so the app runs faster.
La cuenta es opcional y la app funciona:
The account is optional and the app works the same without it. It lets you use your account's %@ on iPhone, Android and the web with the same email, link this browser with the phone app and redeem gift codes. To sign in, you enter your email and we send you a 6-digit code, valid for 10 minutes, from no-reply@sflfarmhand.com; there are no passwords. To link this browser, the website shows a QR code and a short code, valid for 5 minutes, which you approve from the phone app while signed in.
If you have an account, the app's server stores only:
• Your email, an account identifier and the dates of creation and last sign-in.
• Your open sessions: only a digest (SHA-256 hash) of the session token, the device type (iOS, Android or web), its name or model and the dates. Each session lasts 180 days and is renewed when used.
• Your account's %@ records: source (Apple, Google, Stripe or gift code), product, plan, original transaction identifier (for Google Play, only a hash of the purchase token), expiry date and status.
• The gift codes you redeem: the code, the account and the date.
Sign-in codes are stored only as a hash and are deleted once used or expired. To limit attempts, hashes of the IP and the email are used, and they are deleted after about 2 days.
Los pagos de la web (la suscripción trim:
Web payments (the quarterly subscription, its free trial and the one-time payment plan) are made by card and processed entirely by Stripe (stripe.com) on its own secure payment page (Stripe Checkout). You enter your card details directly into Stripe: they never go through the app or the developer. Stripe handles payment and billing data according to its own privacy policy (stripe.com/privacy).
When you pay, Stripe asks for an email address, to which it sends the receipt with its number. When you return from the payment, the app's intermediary checks the purchase with Stripe and gives this browser a license, which is kept in its local storage (localStorage). To recover %@ in another browser, the intermediary asks Stripe whether your email and receipt number match a valid purchase; the app only receives which plan it is, when it started and when it renews or expires. If you are not signed in, the intermediary does not store your email or your receipt number. If you sign in, this browser's purchase is linked to your account (section 4) so you can use %@ on your other devices. The developer can see purchases in the Stripe dashboard (payment email, amount, date and card country) to manage charges, refunds and support, but never your full card number.
Sin cuenta, toda la información se guard:
Without an account, all information is stored only in this browser (local storage and cache): preferences, the %@ license bought on the web, the last known %@ status and the last copy of your farm. None of this is sent to the developer.
If you sign in, the session token is kept in this browser's local storage and the account data in section 4 is stored on the app's server (Cloudflare Workers, with a Cloudflare D1 database). Your farms, your Farm IDs and your preferences are never stored in the account.
Para mostrarte datos actualizados, la ap:
To show you up-to-date data, the app connects over HTTPS to these services:
• SFL Farmhand intermediary (Cloudflare Workers, api.sflfarmhand.com): farm and marketplace requests go through this service of the app, which adds the access key and forwards them to api.sunflower-land.com. It only receives the Farm ID looked up and does not store your Farm ID, your IP or your farm data (only a temporary in-memory copy of a few minutes to avoid repeating requests). To avoid querying the game once per user, it keeps for a while public game data that is the same for everyone: leaderboards, raffles and their winners, marketplace activity and farm names. The app also sends a random installation identifier used only for the request limit; it doesn't identify you and isn't stored. This same service manages the optional accounts (section 4).
• Cloudflare D1: the database of the app's server, where only the accounts are stored (section 4).
• Cloudflare Email Service: sends the email with the sign-in code from no-reply@sflfarmhand.com; it receives your email and the code.
• api.sunflower-land.com: faction pet data and, through the intermediary, farm and marketplace data.
• sfl.world: community prices and yield data (usually through the intermediary, which keeps a temporary copy; directly if it doesn't respond).
• api.coingecko.com: FLOWER token price (likewise: through the intermediary or directly).
• sunflower-land.com, animations.sunflower-land.com, pets.sunflower-land.com, buds.sunflower-land.com and raw.githubusercontent.com: game images.
• Stripe (checkout.stripe.com and billing.stripe.com): card payments, receipts and subscription management. The app's intermediary also checks your purchases with Stripe.
As with any internet connection, these services receive your IP address and the request made (for example, the Farm ID looked up). Each service handles that information according to its own privacy policy. Cloudflare, as the intermediary's provider, processes technical connection data under its own policy; the developer does not store that information, except for the temporary hashes used to limit sign-in attempts (section 4).
La información de este navegador permane:
Information in this browser stays there until you delete it. You can delete it at any time from Settings → Legal & privacy → "Erase all app data", or by clearing the site's data in your browser. Erasing the data signs you out in this browser, but does not delete your account, cancel a subscription or remove your purchases: they remain recorded at Stripe and you can recover them with "I already have Pro: restore", the email you paid with and the receipt number.
Account data is kept for as long as the account exists. You can delete it whenever you want from Settings → Account → "Delete my account": the account, your email, its sessions and its purchase records are removed from the server immediately. Purchases made on the web can still be recovered with the receipt number and App Store or Google Play purchases remain valid in those stores, but the Pro from redeemed gift codes is lost. "Sign out" only ends the session and does not delete the account. Sessions expire after 180 days without use.
Todas las conexiones usan HTTPS cifrado,: All connections use encrypted HTTPS, the access key for the Sunflower Land API is not inside the app (it is kept encrypted as a secret in the app's intermediary service) and purchases are checked directly with Stripe from the intermediary, with a secret key that is not inside the app either. On the server, session tokens and sign-in codes are stored only as hashes, and each code allows a limited number of attempts. Even so, no system is 100% foolproof.
Si no tienes cuenta, no tenemos informac: If you don't have an account, we have no information about you to access, correct or delete: everything the app stores is on your device and you can delete it yourself. If you have an account, you can ask us for a copy of its data, its correction or its deletion by writing to %@ from the account's email, or delete it yourself at any time from Settings → Account → "Delete my account". Data about your card payments (payment email, amount and receipts) is kept by Stripe: to access, correct or request deletion of it, write to us and we will handle it with Stripe.
Si cambias de navegador o de dispositivo:
If you change browser or device, or clear the browser's data, you can recover your purchases with "I already have Pro: restore" (in the plans sheet or in Settings → %@) by entering the email you paid with and the receipt number shown in the Stripe receipt email.
If you sign in with a %@ account (optional), this browser's purchase is linked to it and you can use %@ in the iPhone or Android app and in other browsers by signing in with the same email; and the other way round, with what you bought on the App Store or Google Play. While signed in you can redeem gift codes (Settings → Account → "Redeem a code"): they give your account Pro for the stated time, are personal and cannot be exchanged for money or resold. The account is personal: don't share it or the sign-in codes. If you delete the account, the Pro from gift codes is lost.
Los pagos de la web se procesan con Stri: Web payments are processed by Stripe and are also subject to its terms (stripe.com/legal). Stripe is not responsible for the app or its support. The iPhone and Android apps are also governed by the App Store and Google Play terms. Without an account, purchases made in those stores and those made on the web are independent; with a %@ account, the Pro from any of them can be used on all platforms.
Sin cuenta, %@ no recopila datos persona: Without an account, %@ collects no personal data: everything is stored only in this browser. With an account, the app's server stores only your email, your sessions and your purchase records. Erasing the data removes your saved farms, preferences, caches and scheduled alerts from this browser and signs you out (the account is not deleted). Your purchases are not lost: they can be recovered with "I already have Pro: restore", the email you paid with and the receipt number.
